title: Nearby habitat
summary: Map a tiny habitat within walking distance and who lives there.
objectives: Note living things and what they need
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

Find a small living patch: roadside trees, pond edge, garden, paddy bund, park corner.

Sketch or list:
- 2 plants
- 2 animals/insects (from safe distance)
- Water / shelter / food clues

Stay safe. Do not disturb nests.

quiz.prompt: A habitat is best described as:

options.label: A place that provides what living things need to survive

quiz.teachBack: Habitats are real places that offer food, water, shelter, and space.

fieldPrompt: Name your habitat patch and list 2 plants + 2 animals/insects + one need you noticed.
successCriteria: Lists living things and at least one need

steady.coachNote: Ask what would happen if litter increased there.

fast.coachNote: Ask for a simple food-chain guess from their notes.

llm.tutorBrief: Outdoor safety. No handling wildlife. Respect private land. Keep wonder central.
llm.personalizeTemplate:
Pace={{pace}}. Local ecosystem={{local_context}}.
Suggest species common to their area. Keep correctOptionId values.
